rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a person who runs, especially in athletics.

example.english: I used to be a runner.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hai6 paau2 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a human entrant in a race or other competition, but not for an election candidate.

example.english: Every runner in this marathon gets a medal.
example.traditional: 今次馬拉松每個參賽者都有獎牌。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 maa5 laai1 sung1 mui5 go3 caam1 coi3 ze2 dou1 jau5 zoeng2 paai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a baseball baserunner.

example.english: The runner got safely back to home plate.
example.traditional: 個跑壘員安全返到本壘。
example.jyutping: go3 paau2 leoi5 jyun4 on1 cyun4 faan1 dou3 bun2 leoi5

rows.note: Use this for a long narrow carpet laid in a hallway or similar high-traffic area.

example.english: We put a runner in the hallway at home.
example.traditional: 屋企條走廊鋪咗條走廊地氈。
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 tiu4 zau2 long4 pou1 zo2 tiu4 zau2 long4 dei6 zin1
